reports.title: La-Z-Boy Incorporated Reports Solid Second Quarter Results; Strong Sales Growth In Both Retail And Core North America La-Z-Boy Wholesale Businesses

guidance.heading: Third Quarter Outlook
section: Taylor Luebke, SVP and Chief Financial Officer of La-Z-Boy Incorporated, said, “We expect fiscal third quarter sales to be in the range of $505-525 million and adjusted operating margin(2) in the range of 4.0-5.5%, reflecting a measured view of the macroeconomic backdrop, uneven consumer demand, and our continued near-term strategic investments and transitional costs as we optimize our plant footprint and progress our distribution and home delivery transformation.”
